authorization_reference: User: Launch training. Consecutive in-scope scratch experiments under program.md.
budget_rationale: Width160 microbatch32 measured 4.1306 s/update, implying 45.895 optimizer hours. One 115-update microbatch16 probe plus sampling/contracts is capped at 15 minutes to determine whether the same effective batch can be run materially faster. This is additional qualification, with all prior 516.627 seconds retained.
selection_rule: Qualify microbatch16 at effective batch128. Choose it for production only if its measured mean and terminal timing are at least 5% faster than microbatch32 and peak allocation is below 18GB; otherwise retain32. No further microbatch sweep is allocated.
production_initialization: New random initialization at update zero after qualification; no qualification weights or optimizer state are saved.
